title: ATP Frontmatter Parse Result
description: Result of extracting and validating YAML frontmatter from an ATP protocol or variable file.

file_path.description: Relative path to the file that was parsed.

classification.description: Classification extracted from frontmatter, if present.

frontmatter_raw.description: Raw YAML text extracted from the file (content between --- delimiters).

parsed_object.description: The parsed YAML object. Null if status is parse-error.

field.description: The frontmatter field that failed validation.

message.description: Human-readable description of the validation error.

severity.description: Severity: info = informational, warn = should fix, critical = blocks use.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code from the frontmatter error code table.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the parse was performed.
